description.value: Yummy Slice Pizza is a Canadian-owned pizza-by-the-slice chain with a Richmond location on Number 1 Road, offering pickup and delivery seven days a week. The menu spans classic and signature pies including a broad range of vegetarian and South Asian-inspired options such as Tandoori Paneer and Yummy Potato. With multiple Lower Mainland locations and a catering program, it is a reliable quick-stop for a hot meal on a Richmond cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at yummyslice.ca confirms an active multi-location pizza chain with a Richmond location at '8900 No 1 Rd' listed on the contact page, matching the OSM address. The front page and about-us page explicitly describe the business as a 'PIZZA TAKEOUT & DELIVERY RESTAURANT' open 7 days a week, confirming takeout service. The menu page lists numerous vegetarian pizzas (Veggie Lovers, Greek, Yummy Paneer, Tandoori Paneer, etc.), confirming vegetarian options; no cycling-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM includes unit number 130 in the address; the website contact page lists only '8900 No 1 Rd' without a unit number — unit may be correct but could not be independently confirmed.
Phone number +1-604-271-0066 from OSM could not be confirmed from the website, as the site does not list per-location phone numbers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza chain with a confirmed Richmond location at 8900 No 1 Rd; takeout available and business is clearly publicly accessible.
